content: Implemented immutable interleaved playback snapshots, lock-free ArcSwap snapshot publication, atomic play/pause/stop/seek transport, allocation-free and I/O-free callback rendering, observable atomic underrun count, and CPAL default f32 system output. Dependencies arc-swap and CPAL are permissively licensed (MIT OR Apache-2.0 / Apache-2.0). Validation: focused playback tests 4 passed; `cargo quality` passed format, Clippy -D warnings, 39 tests, and bench compilation.
